known_boundaries: The adversarial matrix is bounded to the frozen Plan schema, one whitelisted arXiv tool, budgets, cancellation and selected fault points; it is not a general security penetration test.
Subprocess tests kill local fixture Workers and use fake Provider and Atom transports; they do not establish network, Provider or production infrastructure reliability.
Explicit retry after a paid unknown outcome remains a user decision and was not used to manufacture success in W4.4.
W4.4 does not compare candidate quality among A/B/C and does not establish that Planner benefits justify its cost.
No non-terminal product entry or personal-use evidence exists; these remain later acceptance boundaries.
evidence_boundary: W4.4 proves the frozen offline safety and fault matrix for the bounded nine-Step runtime using fixture transports and seven real local process kills. It does not prove live capability, general security, production reliability, comparative research quality, or user value.
authorization_consumed: W4.4 offline safety, budget, recovery and fault matrix only
next_acceptance_point: W4.5 offline A/B/C admission decision; no fixture comparison or admission work begins until the user explicitly enters W4.5
